description: The bar chart illustrates average performance values for a set of methods associated with “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The categories are shown along the horizontal axis, labeled with method names in left-to-right order: “Standard,” “Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “CInGS (w/),” and a final category whose label is obscured by a gray rectangle; the vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Average Performance,” displayed on a linear scale from 0 to 60 with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-unit intervals. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Standard” is orange at approximately 52–53, “Self-RAG” is a light khaki color at approximately 54, “FactTune” is light green at approximately 51–52, “CInGS (w/)” is steel blue at approximately 53–54, and the rightmost bar is dark blue at approximately 59–60. The bars are not shown with error bars or annotations, and there is no legend; the categories do not appear to be sorted by value, and no bar is visually emphasized beyond distinct coloring.
